title: Output gallery
idea: Output gallery: One representative output leads, with a varied sequence of work and readable provenance captions below.
audience: People who need to inspect output within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: The work itself shows differences more convincingly than promotional copy.
avoidWhen: Items cannot be publicly shown with permission.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic collection layout through its inspect output priority and explicit commitment contract: Opening an item reveals its actual context and authorship without inventing clients.
navigation: Output gallery keeps the current inspect output context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: One representative output leads, with a varied sequence of work and readable provenance captions below.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to inspect output; the work itself shows differences more convincingly than promotional copy.
composition.priority: Opening an item reveals its actual context and authorship without inventing clients.

imagery.role: Support the actual inspect output context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use a clear linear selection with generous individual crops on phones.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the output gallery structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no inspect output content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Opening an item reveals its actual context and authorship without inventing clients.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized inspect output content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Opening an item reveals its actual context and authorship without inventing clients.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active inspect output context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
